reviews.text: It is truly uplifting to see how patient, kind, loving and expert Livia treats the dogs. It is reassuring that the dogs spend their hours without their owners in such a pleasant environment. I would recommend her to anyone with a clear heart.

I am very grateful to Eszter for creating a truly small, organized, caring environment where I could entrust my border collie puppy to her for half a year (and she allowed me to go on adventures:) ). The communication with Eszter is clear and unambiguous yet flexible, I am very happy that we have a doggy daycare base, Momo has been going there 1-1 days since then!! :)
The Best Dog guesthouse is a huge help in everyday life, I know that my dog ​​is in the best place at Eszter's.
Thank you very much! Best guesthouse, especially to Áfonya :)
A wonderful place for dogs so that the dogs can travel in peace 😊 …

Holly, our one-year-old Lagotto puppy, felt great with Eszter after two trial days for 12! days. There were only two of them with another dog, and judging by the cute photos she regularly sent, they had a lot of fun together. 🙂 We got her back just as happy and relaxed as we left her. By the way, Eszter is an excellent professional. Holly only goes to her sleepovers. ❤️

Teddy loves it and that's the most important thing to me! It's very reassuring that there is a place where he is safe and cared for😍he even became a cat friend! Eszti is professional, I recommend her with a calm heart! …
